scope: REPLICATION: fixed-time uncertainty after one isolated transversal impact of synthetic 1D ballistic point mass; no controller, no real device, no field safety claim; parent ENG-004 remains OPEN.

plant.domain: One impact only, tau<T<tau+2*e*w/g; initial h>floor; g>0; 0<e<=1; no grazing or Zeno; deterministic known guard/reset parameters.

sensor_model: None: fully observed synthetic initial state; no fitting, training, sensor noise or physical calibration.

nominal_and_fault_separation.nominal: First three frozen cases, Gaussian initial perturbations with diagonal population covariance.
nominal_and_fault_separation.ood: Different gravity, restitution, initial height and horizon in ood_low_gravity, not redrawn from nominal generator.
stop_rules: Stop on second impact, unsupported initial state, non-finite numeric output, wall deadline or budget exhaustion.
No real controls, credentials, paid resources, package installation or network calls from experiment.

sample_plan.covariance_comparison: Compare centered empirical output covariance to J * realized centered input sample covariance * J^T, removing input covariance Monte Carlo variation. This is first-order transport validation, not population calibration or general coverage.
sample_plan.reported_only: Empirical 95% marginal interval coverage using population covariance, mean bias, runtime and same-mode fractions; descriptive, no inference claim.

acceptance.A1_exact_event: Event-aware ballistic-flow and bisection-root solver first-event time absolute error <=1e-11 s, endpoint max absolute error <=1e-10, across all four cases and four step sizes.
acceptance.A2_sensitivity: Saltation-composed Jacobian vs direct derivative of closed-form endpoint: max absolute error <=1e-12; centered finite-difference best-step error <=1e-7.
acceptance.A3_covariance: For all 36 ensembles: relative Frobenius covariance error <=0.005 and >=20-fold smaller than reset-Jacobian-only baseline; all samples must have exactly one impact before T.
acceptance.A4_controls: Pre-impact flow derivative/covariance positive control <=1e-12; reset-only and sign-flipped timing matrices fail A2 with error >1e-3; grid-delay event time error >1e-4 on >=1 frozen case; tampered output fails SHA-256 integrity validation.
acceptance.A5_scope: Preserve all failures and controls. Independent reviewer pending means no independent verification claim; no protected card/evaluator edits; no completion or deployment claims.

budget.definition: 36 ensemble trial configurations, 16 event step-size configurations, 12 finite-difference configurations, controls; <=100 configurations total. Each ensemble has 4096 cheap analytic trajectories.

environment: Python 3.12 standard library only; one cloud CPU process; binary64 synthetic numerical baseline.
